name: tasknotes-macos
description: Native macOS TaskNotes app (SwiftUI over the shared Rust core); see README.md for the CI/local split and the mac:preflight rationale.

scripts.mac:snapshots: bun run mac:preflight && swift test --filter TaskNotesMacTests
scripts.mac:format: xcrun swift-format format --in-place --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App UITests Package.swift
scripts.mac:format:check: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App UITests Package.swift
scripts.mac:analyze: xcodebuild -project TaskNotes.xcodeproj -scheme TaskNotes -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode clean build > .build/xcodebuild.log && swiftlint analyze --strict --quiet --config .swiftlint-analyzer.yml --compiler-log-path .build/xcodebuild.log
scripts.mac:smoke: bun run mac:app:release && bun run scripts/verify-launch.ts
scripts.mac:e2e: bun run mac:generate && xcodebuild test -project TaskNotes.xcodeproj -scheme TaskNotes -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:TaskNotesUITests
scripts.mac:verify: bun run mac:generate && bun run mac:build && bun run mac:test && bun run lint && bun run mac:format:check && bun run mac:app && bun run mac:smoke
